Help with staff rotas in detail
A busy afternoon is easier when you know what to expect
Companion Animal Travel Desk guidance for animal movement

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways keeps pet travel orderly, humane, and calm. Our team records service changes in the desk ledger and works closely with the safety coordinator to reduce avoidable risk.

Travelers should prepare carriers, documents, and feeding plans before arrival. Staff will check each detail with a brisk, professional approach and will guide handling by the least stressful method for the animal. If a pet needs a pause, follow the directions given at the desk and keep the animal secure at all times.

Before departure, confirm the route to the pet lounge and note any local instructions. <<FACT F019>> Present your travel papers in full and allow staff to review the arrangement before you move onward.

For relief stops, follow posted access rules and keep leashes short. <<FACT F016>> If there is any change in the service plan, staff will enter it in the ledger and explain the next step clearly.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
